mappedContracts.statement: A publication catalogue and scheduling-freeze policy must fail closed across every mutation path while allowing read-only inspection and planning.
acceptanceCriteria: All mutation entry points share one policy kernel.
Autonomous-agent tests prove frozen and unapproved flows make zero transport mutations.

mappedContracts.statement: Verify mutation success by reading remote after-state and comparing it to the approved plan.
acceptanceCriteria: A local click, response status, or returned message alone is insufficient.
Missing, duplicate, drifted, scheduled, published, revised, or unscheduled states are reported deterministically.

mappedContracts.statement: Mature the product into a safe multi-publication workspace and Creator OS while preserving local-first operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace manifests, publication profiles, catalogues, calendars, campaign plans, analytics snapshots, and audit receipts use stable IDs.
Cross-publication mutation requires explicit target authority and plan binding.
Batch operations are selector-bound, resumable, and reconciled.
